name: com.xquik/mcp
title: Xquik MCP Server
description: X data platform with 120 REST endpoints, 2 MCP tools, 23 extraction tools, webhooks, and writes.

examples.name: Remote MCP
examples.description: Connect to Xquik as a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server.
examples.config: Add 'https://xquik.com/mcp' as a remote MCP server and provide Authorization: Bearer {XQUIK_API_KEY}.

notes: Authentication uses an Xquik API key.
The well-known server card is available at https://xquik.com/.well-known/mcp.json.
The API documentation is available at https://docs.xquik.com/mcp/overview.
